notes.purpose: Exploratory crossover scan with one fixed ResNet20 source and two target models; no source diversity
notes.prior_access: The same full1000, pilot200 and new800 already had V1 target attack effects evaluated; this is not a fresh confirmation
notes.primary_comparison: BSR M=2 with alpha=epsilon/T minus MI with fixed alpha=epsilon/10, separately for each target
notes.adaptive_followup: Start with G=20/24/28/32/36/40. Refine observed mean sign-change brackets by adding missing even budgets. If an entire target curve is positive at the lower boundary, expand downward as a separate recorded sweep. Report no crossover in range if no bracket is observed; do not assume monotonicity, a unique threshold or a confidence interval for the threshold.
notes.randomness: BSR geometry shared within fixed batches; actual seed is base plus batch index
